newsitem.title: USA: Starwood sells tax exempt bonds.
newsitem.headline: Starwood sells tax exempt bonds.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust said on Friday that it has issued $39.5 million in tax-exempt bonds through the Philadelphia Authority for Industrial Development.
Proceeds to the company will total $38.7 million on the bonds with a coupon rate of 6.5 percent and an effective yield of 6.7 percent, Starwood said.
Starwood said it has a special provision that an investment rating on the bonds would bring the coupon rate down to 6.3 percent.

The bonds are interest only and require no principal payments until their maturity on February 1, 2013, Starwood said. The company will have the option to extend or reissue the debt for an additional 14 years at the market rate, it said.

The bonds are guaranteed by SLT Realty LP, a Starwood Lodging Trust partnership, and are separately secured by the company's 251-room Doubletree Guest Suites and the 177-room Days Inn at Philadelphia's airport.
The net proceeds from the sale of the bonds will primarily be used to fund hotel acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, Starwood said.
